title: 2016 Diet Coke Shrink Wrap Limited Edition Glass Bottle 12oz Unopened
descriptionText:
This limited edition Diet Coke glass bottle is a must-have for any Coca-Cola collector. The bottle features a unique shrink wrap design and is unopened, making it a great addition to any collection. The multi-color graphic with scribbles and circles adds a fun touch to the bottle's overall look. 

The bottle was created in 2016 in the United States and is an original piece of advertising. This item is perfect for anyone who loves soda and wants to add a unique piece to their collection.
